metadata.title: Groupicorn Idaho IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. This September 22, 2026 pass prioritized the listed Idaho gaps, adding official One Love Agency offices in Twin Falls, Pocatello, and Idaho Falls. Shortlists use distinct provider groups and preserve research gaps rather than padding thin markets.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url points to a locally stored PNG acquired from an official provider-controlled source. License clearance is not implied.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIP codes are stored; coordinates are intentionally null pending an audited geocoding pass.
metadata.publication_warning: Verify current program availability, age/track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use.

areas.name: Boise / Treasure Valley
areas.definition: Boise-centered Treasure Valley catchment including the I-84 corridor through Caldwell and Nampa.
areas.adjacency_basis: I-84 corridor and practical south/east Idaho travel connection
areas.scope_note: Dense statewide provider concentration; branches count once per operator.

areas.name: Coeur d'Alene / North Idaho
areas.definition: Coeur d'Alene and the Spokane-adjacent North Idaho corridor.
areas.scope_note: Cross-border Spokane providers are documented as a future regional expansion, not included in this Idaho-only file.

areas.name: Idaho Falls / Eastern Idaho
areas.definition: Idaho Falls-centered eastern corridor including nearby Bonneville and Madison County communities.
areas.scope_note: One Love Agency and existing local providers are retained; exact PHP/IOP scope at the One Love office should be reconfirmed.

areas.name: Pocatello / Southeast Idaho
areas.definition: Pocatello-centered Southeast Idaho catchment along I-15.
areas.adjacency_basis: I-15 corridor toward Idaho Falls and the Magic Valley
areas.scope_note: Moonlight Mountain and One Love Agency are retained; exact track and admission scope should be reconfirmed.

areas.name: Lewiston / North Central Idaho
areas.definition: Lewiston-Clarkston valley and nearby North Central Idaho communities.
areas.scope_note: Riverside Recovery is included with a queued exact-level verification because its current official site does not state IOP/PHP explicitly.

areas.name: Twin Falls / Magic Valley
areas.definition: Twin Falls-centered Magic Valley catchment along I-84 and US-93.
areas.scope_note: One Love Agency is retained from the provider's current site-wide PHP/IOP service grid and exact Twin Falls office page; additional local discovery remains needed.
